versions.short: The bill would extend through fiscal year 2031 and update federal programs that help train, recruit, and keep nurses and nursing school faculty. It would reauthorize grants to increase nursing school enrollment, including for students from disadvantaged backgrounds, as well as grants for advanced nursing education, nurse retention, and better patient care. It would also reauthorize student loan repayment and scholarship programs for nurses who work at facilities with critical shortages and for faculty at accredited nursing schools. In addition, it would add training on telehealth and virtual tools and care for survivors of sexual assault to certain grants. Finally, it would temporarily create grants to supplement faculty salaries for up to three years and grants to establish nursing workforce centers and collect workforce data.
